detection: Length below coordinate tolerance
action: Remove only after native connectivity/DRC verification
caveat: May represent an imported degenerate item

detection: Segment length below configurable limit
action: Inspect for tiny jog or merge opportunity
caveat: Legitimate pad necks and tuning use short segments

detection: Deviation from a multiple of 45 degrees
action: Check whether octilinear routing was intended
caveat: RF launch geometry and rotated pads may intentionally violate this preference

detection: Straight segment width below configured fabrication floor
action: Widen or select an appropriate manufacturing profile
caveat: This is not a current-carrying-capacity calculation

detection: Straight copper segment has an empty net
action: Inspect assignment against schematic and native DRC
caveat: Unassigned intentional copper must be explicitly reviewed

detection: No same-net modeled straight-track/via/pad envelope touches endpoint
action: Inspect local copper and remove only if proven unnecessary
caveat: Zones, arcs, custom pad geometry and overlaps can invalidate graph conclusions

detection: Same-net same-layer equal-width segments have coincident endpoints
action: Inspect and merge duplicate copper with native checks
caveat: Tolerance is configurable; reversal is normalized

detection: Collinear equal-width same-net segments meet at endpoints
action: Consider merging to simplify topology
caveat: Teardrops, tuned constraints or intentional editing handles may explain segmentation

detection: Same-net endpoint joint has interior angle below 90 degrees
action: Inspect overlap, backtracking or acute junction
caveat: Not an acid-trap or fabrication failure proof

detection: Two connected same-net segments have different widths
action: Document required clearance neck, taper or class change
caveat: A transition alone is not a defect

detection: Straight segment leaves rectangular/oval pad envelope at non-cardinal local angle
action: Inspect pad escape and any impedance launch requirement
caveat: Envelope is conservative and does not model roundrect corners

detection: (diameter - drill) / 2 below configured minimum
action: Check manufacturer annular-ring requirement
caveat: Does not account for drill tolerance or padstack-specific geometry

detection: Via drill below configured manufacturing minimum
action: Use a supported drill process/profile
caveat: Blind or microvia manufacturing requires its own profile

detection: Via has no net assignment
action: Check against connectivity intent
caveat: Intentional unassigned mechanical copper may exist

detection: Via touches same-net tracks, arcs, pads or saved filled pours on fewer than two copper layers
action: Check planes, stitching, return and thermal roles before removal
caveat: Uses saved fills, not zone outlines. Uncertain copper withholds affected conclusions; refill in KiCad after edits. Never auto-delete

detection: Via circle overlaps conservative copper pad envelope on shared layer
action: Check via-in-pad intent, plugging/capping and native DRC
caveat: Not a manufacturing clearance proof; roundrect/custom pads are approximate

detection: Same-net via centers within configured distance
action: Review if duplicate/redundant or an intentional array
caveat: Thermal arrays, return fences and high-current stitching are valid

detection: Unbranched endpoint chain length exceeds octilinear lower bound by ratio and absolute amount
action: Search for shorter legal route then refill and run native DRC
caveat: Obstacles, timing and return continuity are unmodeled; not proof of avoidability

detection: Unbranched chain contains many direction changes
action: Inspect unnecessary zigzags against tuning constraints
caveat: Not a violation for intentional meanders

detection: Contiguous equal-width short run between wider segments
action: Try widening the entire narrow run after checking clearance
caveat: Only endpoint chains are analyzed; width changes and branches split runs

detection: Via-bounded chain whose existing path clears modeled obstacles on a common departure/return layer
action: Review moving the existing path to the screened common layer
caveat: Screens copper envelopes and configured clearance/keepouts; uncertain geometry withholds findings. Native DRC still required

detection: Configured net absent from modeled pads/tracks/vias
action: Correct stale contract or board net assignment
caveat: Zones alone do not establish endpoint intent

detection: Net segment width below explicit minimum
action: Fix width or review engineering requirement
caveat: No automatic inference from rail name

detection: Net segment lies outside explicit allowed layer list
action: Route on intended layer or update approved contract
caveat: Contract must express actual stackup intent

detection: Net via count exceeds explicit budget
action: Review each via role or adjust justified budget
caveat: Return-current vias can be required

detection: Required pad missing or assigned to wrong named net
action: Reconcile schematic pinout and regenerate PCB before routing
caveat: Requires reviewed mapping; does not infer USB or battery pin numbering

detection: Explicit pair exceeds footprint-origin distance or references missing component
action: Move functional group, or use a more specific pin/loop constraint
caveat: Origin distance is not decoupling pin distance or routed loop area

detection: Explicitly paired components occupy different sides
action: Review placement against loop/assembly requirement
caveat: Opposite-side decoupling may be intentional

detection: Declared peer group row/column coordinate spread exceeds tolerance
action: Align declared peers if electrical/mechanical placement permits
caveat: No automatic grouping by reference prefix; missing references fail the contract
